title: Douala September flooding
summary: Local and broadcast reporting describes flooded streets and homes, disrupted school attendance and transport. Follow-up reporting on September 18 describes further impacts.
review_notes: ["News from Sep 11–14 describes rain overnight Sep 10–11. Sep 18 report describes rain Sep 12–13. Could be additional rainfall or inconsistent dating; keep one episode with separately dated observations until checked.", "Only label specific neighbourhood media when its caption supports that locality.", "Municipal gauges are reported by press, not retrieved sensor observations."]

title: Douala humanitarian impact update
summary: September 18 coverage, citing humanitarian reporting, describes approximately 500 affected households and approximately 200 displaced people.
review_notes: ["Original humanitarian report not retrieved; do not label these as independently verified counts or add them to initial-report estimates."]

title: Limbe flooding and Mbende landslide
summary: Reports describe flooding in Limbe and a landslide at Mbende after heavy rain. Keep landslide impacts distinct from flood impacts.
review_notes: ["Greenpeace attributes three deaths to the landslide based on residents; not a flood-only death count.", "Do not imply the MVP has operational landslide prediction."]

title: Kumba flooding
summary: Voice of Nature reports flooding in Kumba during the same August rain episode affecting Limbe.
review_notes: ["Single NGO report read; independent confirmation and town-specific photos still needed. Do not reuse a Limbe image as Kumba evidence."]

title: Greater Accra June 29 floods
summary: Flood reporting supports new locality-specific evidence in Afienya and Tse Addo, plus broader rescue context in Greater Accra.
review_notes: ["Do not count each gallery or regional report as a separate disaster.", "Accra evidence must not be used for Lower Volta map communities."]

title: Persistent flooding in Totopey
summary: An August report describes residents still unable to return home after the June 29 flooding, with water remaining around houses.
review_notes: ["Recovery publication date is not the date the flood began.", "Avoid treating Songor Lagoon as Akosombo spillage without evidence."]

title: Flood impacts at Anlo Afiadenyigba
summary: July reporting describes inundated homes and schools and receding water after Keta Lagoon floodgates opened.
review_notes: ["Do not infer cholera cases from a report expressing concern about disease risk."]

title: Weta rice-farming flood impacts
summary: A July report documents submerged rice fields, damaged farm access and warehouses in Weta.
review_notes: ["Publication is July 16; the article does not establish exact onset.", "Reported cultivated area, affected acres and household counts describe different scopes; do not interchange them."]

title: Samreboi and Asankragwa flooding
summary: NADMO, quoted by Citi Newsroom, attributes flooding to the Samre and Tano rivers overflowing after rain; more than 24 buildings reportedly collapsed.
review_notes: ["One source groups Samreboi under Western North; Citi identifies Wassa Amenfi West in Western. Verify administrative assignment from boundary data."]

title: Central Region June rain-related disasters
summary: NADMO reporting covers flooding alongside structural collapses and other rain-related hazards across multiple districts.
review_notes: ["A regional aggregate is not a single flood polygon or a set of camera locations.", "Do not mix this all-hazards tally with national June-29-only counts."]

title: Nsawam–Pokuase road flooding
summary: A dated Channel One photo gallery documents flooded road sections and stranded vehicles after overnight rainfall.
review_notes: ["New to supplied records, but historical August 2025 footage; never label 2026."]

title: Weija downstream flood assessment
summary: NADMO discusses flood impacts and encroached buffer zones during a September assessment.
review_notes: ["Assessment date confirmed; new flood onset, town list, inundation extent and photo capture dates not established. Keep report card until resolved."]

title: Ghana June flooding national impact update
summary: An August ministerial update revises national impacts; preserve its as-of date and original reporting scope.
review_notes: ["Not comparable automatically to early July displaced-person totals.", "Regional counts in article do not fully reconcile with headline totals; retain the discrepancy and seek primary official update."]

title: Circle Plastic Market flood and fire aftermath
summary: Later coverage describes traders rebuilding after a flood followed by fire at the market.
review_notes: ["Fire damage and trader portraits must not be labeled floodwater observations."]

title: Bagre–White Volta warnings and Daboya monitoring
location_names: ["White Volta basin", "Daboya–Sisipe crossing", "North East Region", "Northern Region"]
summary: August warning and postponement reports are followed by September monitoring at Daboya.
review_notes: ["No verified community inundation is established by these advisories.", "Keep Aug 9 planned release, Aug 11 postponement and Sep 4 monitoring as separate observations; release status is inconsistent.", "Do not import conflicting reservoir levels or arithmetic as sensor data."]

title: Cameroon seasonal flood and landslide warning
summary: Press reporting relays ONACC seasonal forecasts and MINHDU warnings for flood-prone towns and unstable slopes.
review_notes: ["Retrieve the original bulletins before issuing public alerts.", "Forecast risk does not establish observed flooding in those locations."]
